name: Achievement Unlocked
look: An Xbox 360 style notification on a pale gray-green background: a dark gray rounded bar with the silver and green Xbox logo on the left and bold white letters reading "ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED".
use: Celebrates a small, odd or embarrassing accomplishment as if it were a video game trophy. The caption names the everyday feat, sometimes with a made-up point value.
slots: the points or reward earned (below the badge)
examples: Remembered why I walked into the room
describe: xbox popup that says achievement unlocked
gray game notification with the green x logo
console notification bar for completing something
gamer achievement popup for doing something small
origin: Imitates the achievement pop-up from Microsoft's Xbox 360 console.
